newsitem.title: SOUTH AFRICA: RUGBY UNION-SPRINGBOKS TO PLAY 13 TESTS IN 1997.
newsitem.headline: RUGBY UNION-SPRINGBOKS TO PLAY 13 TESTS IN 1997.

text.p: World Cup champions South Africa have added another two tests, against Italy and Romania, to their 1997 schedule giving them a total of 13 tests this year, Springbok manager Andre Markgraaff said on Thursday.
An extra test has been slotted in ahead of the three-test tour by the British Lions in June and July. South Africa will play either Italy or Romania in Cape Town on either June 10 or 12.
"People may say it is wrong to add another test, but you must understand that the Lions will have eight matches under their belt before the first test and we must be ready for them," said Markgraaff.
"We thought of Italy for the match because as they've displayed in matches earlier this year they have virtually reached Five Nations standard. Romania are also growing in strength.
"Whoever we play it will be a hard, physical match and that is exactly what we require to prepare for the Lions".
The team that does not travel to Newlands will have the compensation of a home tie against the Springboks on November 8.
It will be the first match of a five test tour which also takes in France, England and Scotland.
South Africa test schedule for 1997:
10 or 12 June v Italy or Romania, Cape Town
21 June v British Lions, Cape Town
28 June v British Lions, Durban
5 July v British Lions, Johannesburg
19 July v New Zealand, Pretoria
2 August v Australia, Brisbane
9 August v New Zealand, Auckland
23 August v Australia, Pretoria
8 November v Italy or Romania, venue to be announced
15 November v France, venue to be announced
22 November v France, venue to be announced
29 November v England, Twickenham
6 December v Scotland, Murrayfield
